description: Search published salon suites, booths, chairs, and entire salons. city or lat and lng are required. Results sort ok prices first; unusual and invalid prices come last. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Treat unusual or invalid prices as unverified: do not quote them as typical, pass along priceNote, and suggest confirming with the owner. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals. Featured (paid) listings that match every filter, including an ok priceQuality, are shown first with paidPlacement true and a promotedNote. Tell the user these are paid placements. The rest are ranked by fit.
name: search_listings
